description: Add a practical Homebase admin authentication boundary and tighten destructive operation authorization so tailnet access alone is not the only guardrail for host management.

timing.plannedEarliestExecution: Before broader/non-founder use; can start earlier if VM is exposed to more users
timing.gatingCondition: Requires choosing PIN/passphrase/session model and migration path for existing Homebase installs.

principles: Tailnet access is necessary but not sufficient for destructive host operations
Use a simple admin model before full user accounts
Server-enforced auth, not cosmetic UI locking
Do not expose secrets after save

techStack.runtime: HTTP-only signed session cookie, SQLite config/auth storage
techStack.storage: SQLite admin credential/session/audit tables or config records
techStack.testing: Endpoint auth tests plus manual browser lock/unlock validation

userStories.title: Require admin unlock for destructive operations
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap execute, install execute, backup real, restore real, update, rollback, and service publishing require unlocked admin session
Dry-runs remain available without full unlock or have a lighter confirmation policy
Unauthorized API calls return clear 401/403 responses
userStories.testStrategy: Endpoint tests for protected actions and manual browser verification

userStories.title: Admin setup, unlock, lock, and rotation
acceptanceCriteria: First-run admin setup is available from UI
Admin credential is hashed, never plaintext
Unlock session is HTTP-only and time-bounded
Admin can rotate credential and manually lock
userStories.testStrategy: Manual browser session tests and endpoint tests

userStories.title: Audit destructive actions
acceptanceCriteria: Destructive action attempts record actor/session, timestamp, action, target, outcome, and job id where applicable
Settings or job detail can expose audit context without clutter
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests for audit writes and manual inspection after actions

high: Adding auth late can break recovery flows if not carefully staged
medium: Too much friction could slow founder testing
Session storage needs to be robust across service restarts
low: Pattern can borrow from Family Plan settings PIN work

preFlightChecklist: Choose PIN vs passphrase language for Homebase
Decide whether first-run setup is env-seeded or browser-created
Define emergency recovery path if admin credential is lost
